messages:
sophie: Quick sync re: PM postmortem follow-ups — thinking we need a quarantine switch + safety-window timers for staged rollouts. High level ask: owner for infra toggle, owner for detection hooks, owner for automation to throttle/stop a rollout. TL;DR: assign owners + dates.
aj: +1. Propose we split into 3 pieces: 1) global kill/quarantine switch 2) stage limiter (percent cap per rollout) 3) automated circuit-breaker (error/latency based). I can own the stage limiter. ETA: Wed next week for design doc.
maria: I can take detection hooks / monitors (3). Will add Prom / Datadog monitors and dashboard panels. ETA: EOD Fri. Will wire alerts to #eng-oncall and Slack.
kevin: I’ll own the global kill switch + runbook. Want a simple API + UI button that ops can hit. Prototype by end of sprint. Also we should add feature-flag metadata fields so the runtime understands limits: max_stage_pct, safety_window_seconds, cb thresholds.
aj: Example flag metadata snippet to standardize:
```
max_stage_pct: 10
safety_window_seconds: 3600
circuit_breaker:
  error_rate_threshold: 0.05
  cooldown_seconds: 600
```
jules: Can we also add a backstop auto-shutdown rule when errors AND latency spike together for N minutes? Rollout automation should have a safe default: 5% max + 30m safety window, but writable per-flag. Who'll own the rollback automation that calls the kill switch? 
deploy-bot: incident-bot: incident #456 marked resolved. Linking to postmortem: https://redwood/postmortems/456 — recommend follow-ups be tracked there.
sophie: I'll add action items to the postmortem tracker with owners and dates. Proposed initial assignments: kill switch (kevin) 2w, detection hooks (maria) 1w, stage limiter (aj) 1.5w, rollback automation (tbd). Sync: Tue 10:00 for handoff and API contract review.
kevin: :thumbsup: Add me as owner for SRE side; need SLO owners to sign off on thresholds (cc @product and @platform). I'll draft a short runbook with steps + Slack playbook buttons.
maria: FYI I'll create two datadog monitors: rolling 5m error-rate > 3% and 15m p95 latency > 2s for the service. I'll also add a table of historical rollout spikes so we can pick sane defaults.
aj: Thanks — I'll open the PR for the stage limiter and include a tiny traffic simulator so we can test ramping rules in CI. Will include unit tests + integration tests that fake error spikes.
sophie: Great. Also adding a recurring quarterly audit to the tracker to review rollout incidents and update defaults if we see recurrence patterns. Please add any missing owners as comments in the tracker.
deploy-bot: note: linking incident #456 -> postmortem follow-ups created. Reminder: please update the tracker when PRs land.
kevin: One more ask: expose a usage metric for "percent-of-traffic-in-rollout" by flag so we can backfill when investigating. Whoever owns the flag metadata should ensure telemetry emits that.
sophie: Agree — adding to the checklist. Ok team, thanks — we’ll confirm owners + timelines in tomorrow's sync.
